elements_selected.content: Change Literal::predicate_ids from Vec<SymbolId> to predicate_args: Vec<Term>. Update all accessor methods (predicate_ids() -> &[Term], predicates(), from_ids(), new()). Update Eq/Hash impls to work with Term. Update all call sites across spindle-core that destructure predicate_ids — primarily grounding.rs match_literal, apply_substitution_to_literal, pipeline.rs, reason.rs, scalable.rs, query.rs, explain.rs, index.rs. Existing code should construct Term::Symbol(id) where it previously used bare SymbolId. This is the highest-risk change — audit every match arm.
